fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of commands that leverage the "mshtml.dll" RunHTMLApplication export to run arbitrary code via different protocol handlers (vbscript, javascript, file, http...)
fields.name: Mshtml.DLL RunHTMLApplication Suspicious Usage
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\..\\" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "mshtml") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "#135" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "RunHTMLApplication")))
